title: QA Analyst & Engineer • Founder @ Intelektus • AI & Automation Architect
summary_pt: Mais de 10 anos de experiência como QA Engineer e Especialista em Automação de Processos com n8n, Python e Agentes de IA. Atuação sólida em telecomunicações na Netcracker e fundador da Intelektus.
summary_en: Over 10 years of experience as a QA Engineer and AI Automation Architect translating complex business challenges into high-reliability software. 5+ years at Netcracker Technology testing telecom platforms for Tier-1 global carriers (Du Telecom Dubai, TELUS Canada, Nuuday Denmark), and founder of Intelektus building autonomous AI agents and n8n workflows.
